science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: The Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea tore at Hector's reinforced trench coat as he sprinted along the precarious dock. The howling vortex of metallic winds drowned out the crunch of his insulated boots on the rusting grates, and the sharp scent of raw ozone mixed with the bitter tang of engine grease. Blinding arcs of violent static illuminated the churning, pitch-black sea below, reflecting off his protective goggles in dizzying flashes, leaving a distinct static tang dancing on his tongue. Fighting against the impossible pressure, he gripped the vital telemetry baton tightly in his right hand and shoved it directly into Kaio's waiting grasp, ensuring it was safely in Kaio's possession before the next surge of magnetic interference hit.
